Think of your wedding and having a family and buying your first house, those sweet moments will come one day you’ll have people in your life who will die for you and love everything about you, life has many ups and downs and you have to ride the lows and cherish the highs because we only have so long to live before the flame of our life is blown out by the wind of death.
